title: India Overtakes US in PPP-Based Global Savings (Trails Only China)
summary: EAC-PM working paper reveals India's global savings share rose to 10.3% in 2025.

blocks.content: EAC-PM working paper reveals India's global savings share rose to 10.3% in 2025.

items: Global Rankings: India became the world's 2nd-largest contributor to global savings in PPP terms (10.3% share).
Top Country: China ranks 1st globally with a 31.9% share of global savings.
Historical Growth: India's share rose from 3.3% in 1992 to 10.3% in 2025.
